elementary_derivations: Every legal full orientation admits a strictly positive circulation with its exact physical signs.
A finite polygonal path in the good real-flow space yields a legal single-identity reversal word; zero identities are certified by a k-arc-strong deletion orientation.
The good-flow space and the physical orientation flip graph have exactly corresponding connected components.
Bad flows can be covered using only bond shores and k-1 allowed outgoing identities.
Each bad bond cone is the inverse image of a negative orthant under a surjective linear projection; its lineality codimension is cut_size-k+1, at least k+2.
For k=2, good flows are exactly circulations satisfying the strict polygon inequality on every cut.
Every finite bad-cone intersection admits an exact mixed-quotient cycle/DAG classification, a physical circulation witness, and a dimension formula.
Same- and mixed-polarity uncrossing give uniform cone inclusions and exact physical allowed-set budget identities.

On intersections meeting the lower good-flow layer, the nonempty-intersection index complex admits finite laminarization by strictly decreasing shore-size potential. This is only an index-complex result.
screened_obstructions: Bad cones themselves are full dimensional, although their lineality has large codimension.
Opposite bad cones may intersect in a noncontractible sphere; ordinary good-cover nerve reasoning is not automatic.
Uniform k-dependent flow-ratio certificates do not cover all legal sources, already in arbitrarily large simple complete graphs.

Even two same-shore cones can have an intersection with the lower good-flow layer containing at least binomial(2r,r) components, for arbitrary r and arbitrarily large simple graphs satisfying the original threshold.
unproved: Connectedness of the unrestricted good-flow space under lambda >= 2k+1.
Vanishing of degree d-2 reduced cohomology of the bad-cone union.
A graph-specific cone-elimination or safe continuous-detour mechanism with a termination proof.
